problem: Radiology bookings, referrals and calls are manual, causing call abandonment and missed appointments.
business_model: Success based pricing per the company site

competitors.name: PocketHealth Conductor
competitors.what: Agentic AI that reads orders, calls patients and schedules

competitors.name: IntelePeer Smart Suite
competitors.what: Agentic patient interactions extended to radiology

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice AI plus RIS and EHR integrations and booking rules is standard with some hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and encoded clinic rules create lock in once live.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors launching agentic scheduling; outcome unknown.

market_need_then: 24% of outpatient imaging appointments are missed per a 2025 study cited by RamSoft; company claims call abandonment fell from 30% to 2%.

brand_strength.rationale: Name shared with another US company named Avoca; no brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Avoca Systems is a six person Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. It reports live use in more than 250 clinics (company claim) and strong compliance certifications, which suggests early traction in Australia, but it expands into the US against agentic competitors.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked $500K seed Sept 2026 with YC and Rebel Fund, Dealroom $125k; no primary source. Sources conflict on HQ (Sydney vs San Francisco). Primary partner Jon Xu. Founder education not found.
